sketch:
Observe: SVG schematic with a generator (E, r) driving a non-linear
receiver (dropdown: resistor, motor, or diode). Side panel shows two
overlaid curves: generator characteristic U = E − r·I (decreasing
line) and receiver characteristic. The intersection = point de
fonctionnement — highlighted with a big dot; readouts I*, U*.
Sliders adjust E, r, and receiver parameter. Student sweeps
parameters and watches the operating point move. Experiment: reach a
target operating point (I*, U*) by tuning E. Evaluate: intersection
dot hidden; student predicts I* by mental line-intersection, then
reveals. Wrinkle: "two curves = one solution" clicks; non-linear
receiver (diode) shows why graphical solving beats algebraic.
